_comment: Declared topology: the nodes and flows you assert SHOULD exist.
Copy to topology.json (gitignored) and describe your own fleet.
Nothing here is required. With no topology.json the graph declares nothing
and every peer it observes becomes external:<ip> -- a legitimate way to
start: watch first, declare once you know what normal looks like.
A node may list several addresses; all of them fold onto the one node, so
a host seen by its LAN address and its VPN address is still one host.
A declared edge with expected_min_rate > 0 is monitored for silence: if the
traffic stops, the edge goes SILENT and the node it feeds goes DEGRADED.
'self' is the node id of the host running LogNode. Flows parsed out of
ingested logs are attributed to its service nodes (<self>:lognode,
<self>:dnsmasq), so it should match one of the node ids below.

nodes.name: hub (log collector)
nodes.role: Runs LogNode, Postgres and the local model

nodes.name: Metrics Cloud
nodes.role: Hosted metrics/logs backend, rotating load-balancer addresses
